method: Streaming ZIP member SHA-256 and CRC; bounded ASCII Bilibili URL-prefix scanning in bundled text and ELF64 allocated non-executable sections
limitations: URL strings do not establish requests, verbs, schemas, reachable code or active hosts.
Query/fragment values and non-ASCII URL portions are omitted by the URL-prefix pattern.
DEX routes and generated metadata are covered by separate catalogs; dynamically downloaded resources and native call graphs are outside this scan.
